data.body:
Investigated: this requires a small design decision (config-key naming and fallback semantics) plus changes to plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py and dso-config.conf. Recommended minimum-viable fix:

1. Add bridge.default_assignee key to dso-config.conf (Jira account email or accountId)
2. In acli-integration.py create_issue path: when ticket_data.assignee is not a valid Jira user (existing failure path that currently drops to retry-without-assignee), substitute bridge.default_assignee before retrying. Only fall back to unassigned if neither resolves.
3. Add a BRIDGE_ALERT when substitution happens so operators can audit which tickets had author overrides applied.
4. Add bridge.user_map (key=local_name → value=jira_email/accountId) as a follow-up enhancement for explicit per-author mapping.

Deferring active fix to avoid stacking more bridge-handler changes onto PR #65 (which already has 10 commits and several bridge fixes). Will pick up in a fresh PR after PR #65 lands.
